blocks.text: OKLAHOMA CITY–Onyeka Okongwu scored 28 points, Nickeil Alexander-Walker added 19 and the Atlanta Hawks outlasted the Oklahoma City Thunder 117-112 in the NBA on Wednesday night. Jalen Johnson had 16 points, 12 rebounds and 11 assists for Atlanta (9-6), which made 20 of 50 3-point shots (40%). Lu Dort (16) and Aaron Wiggins (14) combined for 30 points in their return to Oklahoma City.
